title: R6 capability-aware scaffolding: per-tier prompt_scaffold in profiles (balanced/fast tiers get a numbered DoD with mandatory machine-checkable evidence lines; deep stays terse) + measured effort per phase/tier
summary: Gap G8: build-prompt bytes are identical whether the phase lands on codex-tmux/balanced or a hypothetical fast tier; internal/capability models transport only. Evidence: SWE-agent 'interface design moves success as much as model choice' (2405.15793); effort dials are non-monotonic for small models (2604.26954) — measure, do not assume.
root_cause: No tier/capability signal reaches prompt assembly; effort_level is a static profile field.
fix: profiles gain prompt_scaffold keyed by tier (config-injected, Strategy); assembler selects by resolved tier; dashboard records per-phase tier/effort so ship rate by tier×effort is measurable before pinning.
acceptance: A balanced-tier build prompt contains the scaffold block; a deep-tier prompt does not; unit test pins both.
No Go literal holds scaffold text.
